core_regressions.measurement: Guest clock times 128 pipe round trips per memory case; excludes initial COW materialization. Selected preemption, translation and selected Linux mapping implementation included. Memory means are arithmetic sample means, including phase boundaries; sampled peaks can miss short peaks. Resident lifetime peak is separate.

limitations: Adapted Bionic/ART from current system image; not unmodified Android.
No full APK installation, Android desktop, or iPhone translation integration.
Single Linux CPU; 64 ELF layouts; only supported 16 KiB ELF layouts.
Dynamic code uses the existing explicit publication protocol; other JITs and arbitrary write aliases remain unverified.
Memory means are arithmetic sample means; peaks may miss short events. Internal translation-cache capacity flushes are not counted by the host.
